'''May 2001 Madrid tournament (12 May)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 12 May 2001. [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]] won it. It is known from Angel San Jose's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2295">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-ithor-madrid-may-12-2001d2295/ ithor-madrid-may-12-2001], DeckTech (Angel "Dj" San Jose, 13 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-13-ithor-madrid-may-12-2001d2295/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Miguel Tarin Vegas]]
